themes.title: Right-wing leaders rally behind restrictive birthright citizenship policies
themes.blurb: Multiple right-wing governments and parties across the U.S., Italy, and Hungary are pushing for stricter birthright citizenship laws, framing it as a national security and sovereignty issue. This theme reflects a coordinated effort to challenge long-standing legal interpretations of citizenship rights, often targeting immigrant communities and appealing to nationalist sentiments.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: President Trump signed executive orders to restrict birthright citizenship, targeting children of foreign diplomats and government employees.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian far-right parties have echoed anti-immigration rhetoric, aligning with broader nationalist policies.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungary's government has historically promoted restrictive citizenship policies, reinforcing nationalist narratives.

themes.title: Far-right parties exploit migration crises for political gain
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in Spain, Italy, and Poland are leveraging recent migration crises to amplify anti-immigrant rhetoric and push for stricter border controls. This theme highlights how these parties frame migration as a security threat, often clashing with EU policies and neighboring countries over border management and migrant redistribution.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox has escalated anti-immigration rhetoric in response to the Ceuta migration crisis, demanding military deployment and rejecting migrant redistribution.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italy's government, led by Meloni, has maintained border controls with Spain, rejecting EU pressure to lift restrictions.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS has proposed deporting unemployed Ukrainian men, exploiting anti-immigrant sentiment for political gain.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing administrations in the U.S., Argentina, and Hungary are rolling back or restructuring social programs, citing fiscal responsibility and economic efficiency. This theme underscores a broader trend of austerity measures, often framed as necessary reforms to reduce government spending and debt.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: The Trump administration proposed deep cuts to Head Start and other social programs, arguing for deregulation and fiscal restraint.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei's government has pushed for austerity measures, including cuts to public sector wages and social programs.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungary's government has introduced tax cuts and energy subsidies while reducing funding for certain social initiatives.

themes.title: AfD surge reshapes German politics ahead of regional elections
themes.blurb: Germany's far-right AfD party is gaining significant traction in regional polls, particularly in Saxony-Anhalt, where it leads with 36-41%. This theme captures the party's rising influence, its impact on mainstream parties, and the broader implications for German politics, including potential coalitions and policy shifts.

themes.title: Right-wing leaders face internal divisions and leadership challenges
themes.blurb: Internal conflicts and leadership struggles are emerging within right-wing parties across Poland, Italy, and Argentina. This theme highlights how factionalism, ideological differences, and personal rivalries are undermining party unity and complicating electoral strategies ahead of upcoming votes.
